description: This source file defines the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, which includes functions to discover Tailscale gateways by probing nodes in a Tailscale network. It contains data structures, utility functions for process execution, network probing, and JSON parsing, and orchestrates asynchronous tasks for network discovery.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered Tailscale gateway with display name, DNS, host, and port.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main function to asynchronously discover Tailscale gateway beacons within a specified timeout.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects candidate nodes from Tailscale status data to probe further.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read the current Tailscale status JSON output from various possible executable locations.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path of a Tailscale executable candidate considering the environment PATH.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to a host to check for a specific challenge event indicating it's a gateway.

methods.name: isConnectChallenge
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket message indicates a connect challenge event.
